content: [Part 1 - Picture 1] Look at the photograph of a meeting room and choose the statement that best describes what you see.

choices.label: A
choices.text: They are arranging chairs around the table.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A woman is pointing at a chart on the screen.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Some documents are being placed in a folder.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The projector is being mounted on the ceiling.

correctChoice.label: B
correctChoice.text: A woman is pointing at a chart on the screen.

explanation: Đáp án B đúng: Người phụ nữ đang chỉ vào biểu đồ trên màn hình thuyết trình.

content: [Part 1 - Picture 2] Look at the photograph of a warehouse and choose the statement that best describes what you see.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Boxes are stacked on wooden pallets.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Workers are loading a delivery truck.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A man is sweeping the warehouse floor.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Safety helmets are hanging on the wall.

correctChoice.label: A
correctChoice.text: Boxes are stacked on wooden pallets.

explanation: Đáp án A đúng: Các thùng hàng đang được xếp chồng lên các tấm pallet gỗ.

content: When is the client from London arriving?
explanation: Câu hỏi When (Khi nào) -> Đáp án B trả lời mốc thời gian 'Tomorrow afternoon at two o'clock'.

content: Who is responsible for ordering the new office printers?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ms. Davis from the IT department.

correctChoice.label: A
correctChoice.text: Ms. Davis from the IT department.

explanation: Câu hỏi Who (Ai) -> Đáp án A chỉ người phụ trách là cô Davis phòng IT.

content: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
explanation: Trong đoạn hội thoại, người phụ nữ hỏi về 'updated budget report for the marketing campaign'.

content: Why have travel expenses increased?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Employees will attend a trade show in Singapore.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A consultant was hired from abroad.

correctChoice.label: C
correctChoice.text: Employees will attend a trade show in Singapore.

explanation: Người phụ nữ giải thích: 'that's because of the upcoming trade show in Singapore next month'.

content: Where does this announcement most likely take place?
explanation: Thông báo nhắc tới 'board Flight 402 to Tokyo' và 'Gate 14B' -> tại sân bay.

content: What are passengers invited to do at Gate 14B?
explanation: 'enjoy complimentary refreshments at Gate 14B' (complimentary = free).

content: The board of directors will meet next Monday to ___ the proposed merger.
explanation: Sau 'to' chỉ mục đích cần một động từ nguyên mẫu (to V) -> chọn 'discuss'.

content: All visitors must wear a security badge ___ they are inside the research facility.
explanation: Sau chỗ trống là một mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh 'they are inside...' nên cần liên từ 'while' (trong khi). 'during' và 'despite' đi với cụm danh từ.

content: Question 11 in passage: 'All full-time employees are (11) ___ to register for a time slot...'
explanation: Cấu trúc bị động 'are required to V' (được yêu cầu làm gì).

content: Question 12 in passage: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank (12).

choices.label: A
choices.text: Late registrations will not be accepted after the deadline.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The company cafeteria will be closed for renovation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Please submit your travel receipts to accounting.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Several new interns joined the marketing team.

correctChoice.label: A
correctChoice.text: Late registrations will not be accepted after the deadline.

explanation: Câu trước nhắc hạn đăng ký là thứ Sáu 5:00 P.M., nên câu A (Đăng ký muộn sau hạn sẽ không được chấp nhận) liên kết mạch lạc nhất.

content: What will the first 50 visitors receive on Saturday?
explanation: Đoạn quảng cáo ghi rõ: 'The first 50 customers will receive a free leather notebook.'

content: How can a customer qualify for free delivery?

choices.label: A
choices.text: By signing up for a membership card

choices.label: D
choices.text: By visiting the Oak Street store in person

explanation: Câu cuối đoạn văn: 'Free delivery is available for orders over $150.'
